body:
# Can we make the task page overlap the top bar and stop squishing the top bar

![image.png](assets/image.png)

As can be seen in the image when the task view is big it causes the search bar to take too muchh space up. I think what would be good is to have the search level bar static and let the task bar cover things up (The togglings and show completed arent essential to have on screen always. ) 

This means we can reclaim more task space
